objective: Manager-only composition of the independently accepted CFR-168 Rust file-remote ancestry, HTTP merge-request closure, storage, and file-remote Doctor candidates on canonical 740ea18, followed by one canonical source-document synthesis, the focused composed gate ladder, and a fresh independent review of the exact composed commit. Composition remains blocked until every final candidate SHA and exact ACCEPT report commit/digest is bound.

risk.rationale: The manager must compose four separately reviewed runtime branches, manually reconcile the shared decision-work core, preserve effect and publication ordering, synthesize canonical source truth, and prevent candidate-local evidence from being misrepresented as composed or release completion evidence.

disallowed_actions: Create or run a dev-swarm manifest while this packet is blocked
Start composition before all four exact final candidates and independent ACCEPT report commits and SHA-256 digests are bound
Integrate or partially salvage any candidate whose exact review decision is REQUEST_CHANGES
Merge review, task, result, manifest, or recovery-control history as product implementation history
Resolve work_budget.rs or canonical source-document overlap by taking one branch blob without semantic reconciliation
Add behavior not already covered by an exact accepted candidate; create a separately reviewed successor instead
Parallelize Cargo, reuse per-lane passing output as composed evidence, or skip a required focused gate
Claim closure of Explain combined ownership, the typed Store signal, or separately owned local merge, scan, clone, storage-report, or GC residuals
Update canonical, issue status, release status, Install, Dogfood, Close, or Retrospect from this packet
Discard user changes or mutate an implementation or independent-review worktree

non_goals: Implement a new product fix while resolving composition conflicts
Change Python fallback, Store types, Explain, packaging, devcontainer, CI, agent wrappers, or dogfood project code
Close separately owned local merge, scan, clone, storage-report, GC, typed Store, or Explain residuals
Raise public limits, weaken subject validation, or change accepted error precedence
Merge canonical or run Install, Dogfood, Close, or Retrospect
Treat four candidate-local acceptances as proof that the composed tree is accepted

invariants.statement: Every ported implementation commit belongs to the exact final candidate bound by an independent ACCEPT report commit and report digest.
invariants.falsification_test: Substitute a parent, sibling, abbreviated-only hash, worker-success state, or report for another candidate and require the packet to remain blocked.

invariants.statement: The manager composes ancestry, HTTP closure, storage, Doctor, and one source-document synthesis in that order, with no partial salvage from a REQUEST_CHANGES candidate.
invariants.falsification_test: Omit or reorder one accepted implementation commit, copy one rejected hunk, or include a control-plane commit and require inventory verification to reject the composition before product validation.

invariants.statement: The final work_budget.rs preserves the ancestry deadline and one-way limit primitives plus the HTTP request-ledger sealer and transactional response-pair primitives without widening or conflating their scopes.
invariants.falsification_test: Delete either primitive family, widen a profile, set a local_v1 deadline, add a third HTTP response sealer, or permit half-consumed response selection and require focused core and route regressions to fail.

invariants.statement: Each composed route has one operation or request ledger, at most one authorized prepublication owner at a time, one terminal observation, and zero retained, temporary, and permit ownership at handoff.
invariants.falsification_test: Inject double seal, partial selection, cleanup failure, session loss, deadline, subject change, encoding failure, and partial publication; require the primary typed outcome, one terminal observation, and zero residual ownership.

invariants.statement: Every accepted subject fence, response preflight, ownership admission, and required fallible cleanup remains before the first applicable authority effect or publication.
invariants.falsification_test: Move ancestry copy, HTTP response preparation, storage response ownership, or the Doctor final subject fence across the first effect and require byte-for-byte pre-effect and response regressions to fail.

invariants.statement: One four-document synthesis describes the exact composed call chains, owners, data models, terminal semantics, and remaining boundaries.
invariants.falsification_test: Restore one pre-candidate row, choose one candidate's whole document blob, or omit an accepted owner and require source/project document checks or the independent trace review to reject it.

invariants.statement: The composition decision covers only the exact four accepted runtime surfaces and leaves every separately owned residual explicitly open.
invariants.falsification_test: Claim closure of Explain combined ownership, the typed Store signal, or adjacent local merge, scan, clone, storage-report, or GC work without a separately accepted candidate and require the composed review to return REQUEST_CHANGES.

invariants.statement: Focused gates and independent review bind the exact clean composed commit and tree; earlier per-lane results are context only.
invariants.falsification_test: Change one composed blob after validation, cite a per-lane run, or review a parent tree and require digest and ancestry checks to reject approval.
